column2: In the handoff fire script's per-account liveness probe, on which line is the shell case pattern that treats a probe as PASSED (the success markers it accepts from the CLI's JSON output)?
The multi-account quota tool reads an unclamped weekly utilization fraction from HTTP response headers. On which line is the header name for the 7-day utilization read?
Which test asserts the exact candidate line that the memory-extraction tool prints, including the model id it ran? Give the file and line of that assertion.
When the research-kit router cannot read the model SSOT, it falls back to model family aliases. Where is that fallback alias map defined?
In the repository's model configuration file, on which line is the effort rung set for code-writing teammates working on an anchored brief?
In the stale-model-reference lint, where is the function defined that decides whether a file is exempt because it matches the classification's preserve list?
The read-before-write shim reads the session's model from the transcript. On which line does it skip the placeholder model value that the harness writes on error turns?
Which line in the landing script makes it refuse to land when it runs inside an Anthropic-hosted cloud VM?
The model-registration checker always counts a control model id beside the requested one. On which line is that control id defined?
The handoff fire script carries its own private copy of the helper that detaches a child into a new session. Where is that copy defined?
In the token ledger, on which line are the price multipliers for 5-minute and 1-hour cache writes defined?
In the handoff fire script, on which line is a failed probe classified as the account lacking access to the model?
In the repository's model configuration file, on which line is the Opus 5.5 effort rung for breadth research workers set?
